rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Crypto MCP provides a bridge between language models and cryptographic operations using the PyCryptodome library. This implementation enables AI assistants to perform various encryption, decryption, hashing, and digital signature operations through a standardized interface. Built with Python and containerized with Docker, it offers a lightweight solution for secure data handling in AI applications where cryptographic capabilities are needed.
